usage: sot-validator curate-import [-h] --curation-db CURATION_DB --snapshot SNAPSHOT --csv CSV
                                   [--preview] [--apply] [--confirm-token CONFIRM_TOKEN]
                                   [--as-of AS_OF] [--actor ACTOR] [--json]

Bulk-import field edits from a patch CSV into an existing SQLite curation database. --preview
opens the database read-only, prints every row's diff and a confirm token, and writes nothing.
--apply --confirm-token TOKEN rebuilds the preview and writes the change rows in one transaction
only if the token still matches. JSON curation files are not supported, and a missing database is
never created.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --curation-db CURATION_DB
                        Existing SQLite CurationStore database. JSON curation files are not
                        supported.
  --snapshot SNAPSHOT   Site JSON snapshot file or SnapshotStore directory the CSV edits apply to.
  --csv CSV             Patch CSV with columns record_type, record_id, field, new_value, reason.
  --preview             Print the per-row diff, status counts, and confirm token; never writes.
  --apply               Write the change rows; requires --confirm-token from a --preview of the
                        same CSV.
  --confirm-token CONFIRM_TOKEN
                        Confirm token printed by --preview; only used with --apply.
  --as-of AS_OF         Optional ISO-8601 UTC time the CSV was prepared; records changed after it
                        are conflicts.
  --actor ACTOR         Operator identifier recorded in the audit log (default: cli-operator).
  --json                Print the preview or apply result as JSON.
